text: The US added 165,000 jobs in October, far above the roughly 65,000 expected, and unemployment fell to 4.1%. September was revised up to 60,000.
Treasury yields jumped after the report: the 10-year to about 4.90% and the 2-year to about 4.54%, as bets on a December Fed hike revived.
Nasdaq-100 futures were up about 1.5–1.6% after the report, bouncing from Thursday's 6.4% fall, though higher yields held back the gains.
Gold slipped to about $4,070 before the report, down 0.4%, after Goldman Sachs cut its end-2026 forecast to $4,150 from $4,650. It is still up about 5% for the week.
The dollar index rose about 0.4% to near 102 ahead of the report.
Brent crude climbed to about $99.90, briefly topping $100, as tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz continued.
Bitcoin steadied near $75,700 after Thursday's sell-off.
